name: Thruster Mode Variant Selection (Disambiguation)
description: Two thruster configurations are available: monopropellant (higher thrust, more propellant) and cold gas (lower thrust, minimal mass). Disambiguation UPR selects the appropriate thrust force CZ based on manoeuvre type.
